title: Rhine Falls / Rheinfall
meta: Waterfall, viewing platforms and boat trips
body: A wide waterfall below Schloss Laufen, with riverside viewpoints, platforms close to the water and boat trips.
caption: Rhine Falls and Schloss Laufen
familyNote: Use the riverside viewpoints or a short round trip without a rock landing. The Rock Experience has over 100 steps and is not recommended below 1.2 metres in height.
aprilNote: The falls can be viewed year-round. Exact boat departures for the 2027 spring season have not been verified.

title: Schaffhausen old town and Munot fortress
meta: Old town and historic fortress
body: Schaffhausen has a historic old town with painted facades and projecting windows. The circular Munot fortress rises above the town and Rhine, surrounded by vineyards.
caption: Munot fortress
familyNote: Munot has steep approaches, stairs and a cobbled ramp, so it takes more effort with a stroller.
aprilNote: Munot's standing October-to-April opening hours are 09:00 to 17:00.

title: Stein am Rhein
meta: Medieval old town and riverfront
body: A compact medieval town where Lake Constance becomes the Rhine. Painted facades and decorated houses surround Rathausplatz, with riverfront scenery nearby.
caption: Painted houses in Stein am Rhein
familyNote: Pair with Insel Werd if the children have energy for another short walk.

title: Insel Werd, Eschenz
meta: Quieter discovery | island, chapel and footbridge
body: A small monastery island near Eschenz, connected to the shore by a wooden footbridge. The chapel overlooks the water; the island also has prehistoric archaeological significance.
links: Thurgau Tourism on Werd and the region
caption: Footbridge to Insel Werd
familyNote: Allow a short visit and combine it with Stein am Rhein.

title: Seebachtal lakes near Hüttwilen and Nussbaumen
meta: Quieter discovery | lakes, walking and nature
body: The Hüttwilersee, Nussbaumersee and Hasensee lie in a protected landscape of reeds, woodland and farmland near Frauenfeld. Lakeside walking and birdwatching are the main activities.
caption: Hüttwilersee in the Seebachtal
familyNote: Choose a short section of accessible route 918 with a stroller. Other natural paths can be muddy after rain.

title: Kartause Ittingen, Warth
meta: Quieter discovery | monastery, gardens and museums
body: A former Carthusian monastery with historic courtyards, gardens, a farm shop, the Ittinger Museum and Kunstmuseum Thurgau. Self-guided discovery routes explore its water, woodland and monastic history.
caption: Kartause Ittingen
familyNote: Short self-guided discovery routes let you choose how far the youngest walks.
aprilNote: The rose display comes later in the year. The museums follow winter opening hours through April.

title: Altnau apple trail and orchard country
meta: Quieter discovery | orchards and a themed trail
body: The Altnau apple trail runs through orchards near Lake Constance, with themed information stations about fruit growing.
caption: Apple blossom in Altnau, flowering is not guaranteed during this visit
familyNote: Choose the trail distance to suit the youngest.
aprilNote: Apple blossom is uncertain this early; use the linked local blossom report to decide whether to make a special journey.

title: Technorama, Winterthur
meta: Interactive science centre | indoors and outdoors
body: A hands-on science centre in Winterthur with hundreds of experiments involving natural phenomena and technology. Visitors operate the exhibits themselves. Indoor galleries and an outdoor experiment park offer different ways to explore.
caption: An exhibit at Technorama
familyNote: The operator recommends The Sound of Wood for small children; children aged 0 to 5 currently enter free.
aprilNote: The standing opening hours are daily, 10:00 to 17:00.

title: Zurich old town, Lindenhof and the lake
meta: Old town, viewpoint and lakefront
body: Zurich's old town spreads along the Limmat, with lanes, churches and riverfront buildings. The elevated Lindenhof has views over the old town; the lakefront opens out toward Lake Zurich. Scheduled boat services add a separate activity on the water.
caption: Grossmünster and the Limmat
familyNote: Use short walks and tram rides to limit walking for the youngest.

title: Zurich Zoo and Masoala Rainforest
meta: Zoo, animal habitats and indoor rainforest
body: Zurich Zoo combines outdoor animal habitats with the indoor Masoala Rainforest.
familyNote: Choose a few animal areas rather than trying to cover the whole zoo with a three-year-old.
aprilNote: Standing March-to-October hours are daily, 09:00 to 18:00, with Masoala opening at 10:00.
caption: Inside the Masoala Rainforest at Zurich Zoo

title: Lucerne old town and lakefront
meta: Historic city, wooden bridge and lake
body: Lucerne's covered wooden Chapel Bridge crosses the Reuss beside the Water Tower. The old town has historic squares and painted buildings, while the lakefront looks across Lake Lucerne toward the mountains. Scheduled lake cruises are another activity from the city.
links: Chapel Bridge and its Water Tower
caption: Chapel Bridge, Lucerne
familyNote: Pair with the transport museum if the children prefer an indoor activity.

title: Swiss Museum of Transport / Verkehrshaus
meta: Interactive transport museum | indoors and outdoors
body: An interactive museum about transport and mobility, with trains, aircraft, road vehicles and shipping exhibits. The planetarium, cinema and Swiss Chocolate Adventure have separate ticket or package arrangements.
links: Plan a visit and compare tickets
caption: Swiss Museum of Transport
familyNote: Activities start from age 2. The traffic garden is for ages 4 and up; the Chocolate Adventure is recommended from age 6.
aprilNote: Open 365 days a year under the standing policy.

title: Rigi by cogwheel train
meta: Mountain railway and viewpoints
body: Cogwheel railways reach Rigi's viewpoints above Lake Lucerne. The Vitznau route provides a lakeside approach to Rigi Kaltbad and Rigi Kulm.
caption: Rigi railway in snowy conditions
familyNote: Allow time for rail transfers and choose short paths with a three-year-old.
aprilNote: Use Vitznau both ways; its published timetable covers the full visit. Goldau-Rigi Staffel is closed 5 to 23 April 2027, and Weggis-Rigi Kaltbad is under maintenance through 2 April. Snow may remain on mountain paths.

title: Natur- und Tierpark Goldau
meta: Wildlife park, woodland and family activities
body: A wildlife park in the wooded landscape of the Goldau landslide, home to native and European animal species. Some deer and other animals move through free-ranging areas, alongside larger animal enclosures.
familyNote: Playgrounds add variety to the visit. Choose the main routes with a stroller; some paths are less accessible.
aprilNote: The standing April-to-October opening hours are daily, 09:00 to 18:00.
caption: Visitors at the bear and wolf enclosure in Goldau

title: Thun old town, Schadau Park and castle
meta: Old town, lakefront park and an optional castle visit
body: Thun's old town sits beside the Aare below its medieval castle. Schadau Park adds an open lakeside setting at the outlet of Lake Thun. The castle museum provides views across the town, lake and mountains.
familyNote: The castle interior has many stairs and no internal lift, so make that part optional for the youngest and leave the stroller outside the museum.
aprilNote: The castle's standing April-to-June opening hours are daily, 10:00 to 17:00, with last entry 30 minutes before closing.
links: Castle hours, stairs and family access
caption: Thun old town and castle

title: Spiez bay on Lake Thun
meta: Lakefront, harbour and castle
body: Spiez's bay on Lake Thun has a harbour, a castle park and church above the waterfront, with vineyards behind. Boats connect it to other Lake Thun destinations.
caption: Spiez Castle and Lake Thun
familyNote: Allow for the hill between the railway station and the waterfront.
aprilNote: The castle museum, shop and cafe are closed until 1 May 2027. The park remains accessible; the church's standing winter hours are weekdays 10:00 to 17:00, subject to events.

title: Unterseen and the Aare riverside
meta: Quieter discovery | old town and riverside
body: A historic town beside the Aare, near Interlaken West. Stadthausplatz, old buildings and the riverside are the main sights. Unterseen offers a quieter town setting close to central Interlaken.
caption: Unterseen and the Aare
familyNote: Short, flexible walks work well around the youngest child's energy.

title: Harder Kulm above Interlaken
meta: Mountain viewpoint and funicular
body: A funicular from Interlaken reaches this viewpoint above the town, with views over Lakes Thun and Brienz.
caption: Harder Kulm and Lake Thun
familyNote: The short approach to the viewing platform suits a brief visit; longer mountain paths take more planning.
aprilNote: An official opening date covering this visit could not be verified.

title: Ringgenberg and a short lakeside walk
meta: Quieter discovery | lakeside village and castle-church
body: Ringgenberg stands on Lake Brienz's north shore, with a castle-church above the lake and paths through woodland and along the shore. Nearby Goldswil and Burgseeli add a smaller lake setting.
caption: Ringgenberg castle-church
familyNote: Choose a short village or lakeside section; longer wooded paths and slopes need more planning with a stroller.
aprilNote: Spring 2027 boats do not call at Ringgenberg, so arrive by land. Burgseeli lido is a summer activity.

title: Brienz village and Lake Brienz
meta: Village, chalets and lake cruises
body: A lakeside village known for wooden chalets, woodcarving and its waterfront promenade. Brunngasse is one of its historic streets.
caption: Lake Brienz, viewed from Oberried
familyNote: Take the train in one direction to avoid a full boat round trip.
aprilNote: Lake Brienz boats run from 26 March 2027. The spring timetable has daily Interlaken Ost departures for Brienz at 10:10, 12:10 and 14:10, returning from Brienz at 11:10, 13:10 and 15:10. Steamers start later in the season.

title: Giessbach Falls
meta: Waterfalls, woodland and historic hotel
body: The Giessbach descends through woodland in 14 cascades toward Lake Brienz, beside the historic Grandhotel Giessbach. Paths connect viewpoints around the falls, and a funicular links the lakeside landing with the hotel.
caption: Giessbach Falls
familyNote: Sloping paths can be wet and slippery. A carrier is more practical than relying on a stroller; funicular stroller capacity is limited.
aprilNote: Spring 2027 boats call at Giessbach. The funicular's exact 2027 schedule has not been verified.

title: Aare Gorge / Aareschlucht, Meiringen
meta: Gorge walk and tunnels
body: Walkways and tunnels follow the Aare through a narrow limestone gorge. The Tatzi trail adds a creature-search activity.
links: 2027 dates, Tatzi trail and stroller information
caption: Aare Gorge
familyNote: Narrow, light strollers can reach the main attractions from the west entrance, subject to crowd restrictions.
aprilNote: The west entrance opens 26 March 2027; the east entrance stays closed until 6 May. Opening hours are 08:30 to 17:30, with return via the west entrance.

title: Wengen by train from Lauterbrunnen
meta: Mountain village and railway ride
body: A largely car-free mountain village above Lauterbrunnen, reached by the Wengernalp Railway. The village has traditional chalet architecture and views across the valley.
caption: Wengen village
familyNote: Train access avoids an uphill walk. Allow for slopes within the village.
aprilNote: The village railway runs year-round. Higher paths may still be snow-covered.

title: Lauterbrunnen valley and Staubbach views
meta: Cliff scenery, waterfalls and valley walks
body: A valley of high cliffs, meadows and waterfalls, including Staubbach Falls beside Lauterbrunnen village. Valley-floor paths provide views of the cliffs and falling water.
caption: Lauterbrunnen valley from Wengen
familyNote: Keep the walk short for the youngest; extend the outing with a train ride to Wengen.
aprilNote: The gallery behind Staubbach Falls opens May to October and is closed during this visit.

title: Trümmelbach Falls
meta: Waterfalls inside a mountain
body: Ten glacial waterfalls inside the mountain, reached through a system of tunnels, a lift and stairs. The water drains the glacier walls of the Eiger, Moench and Jungfrau.
caption: Trümmelbach Falls
familyNote: The operator does not admit a three-year-old. Older family members could visit separately; noise and wet surfaces add difficulty.
aprilNote: The usual season begins in early April, subject to weather. The exact 2027 opening date has not been verified.
